selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the passage about the Second Stopping-Place?
questions.answer: It briefly gathers several signs that point to Allah’s oneness and necessary existence.

questions.question: Why does the passage list several different “witnessings” instead of only one?
questions.answer: It aims to build a strong, layered case by showing that many kinds of evidence lead to the same conclusion.

questions.question: Why does the passage begin with the testimony of greatness and sublimity?
questions.answer: Because overwhelming majesty and all-encompassing perfection naturally direct the mind toward one supreme source.

questions.question: How are Divine acts described in relation to limitlessness?
questions.answer: They are shown as appearing absolutely and without end, while still proceeding according to Allah’s will and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage communicate by pairing ease with perfection?
questions.answer: That creation happens effortlessly for Allah without any loss of precision or beauty.

questions.question: What does artistic excellence in created things contribute to the proof?
questions.answer: It shows intention, knowledge, and care rather than accident or disorder.

questions.question: Why is universal order said to be inconsistent with associating partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Because such complete harmony does not fit divided control or rival makers.

questions.question: Why are Divine Names important in this summary of proofs?
questions.answer: Because their unified activity throughout the universe reflects one Lord acting everywhere.

questions.question: Why mention both Names and deeds instead of only one of them?
questions.answer: Because both Divine qualities and Divine actions appear throughout the universe and together reinforce the proof of unity.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the closing Arabic statement as used here?
questions.answer: It affirms that every created thing contains a sign pointing to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: In this passage, what truth is being summarized in a concise form?
questions.answer: The five truths of unity that the traveler has observed in the world.

questions.question: In simple terms, what does the long central sentence try to prove?
questions.answer: It tries to prove that the universe bears witness that Allah is one.

questions.question: What kind of evidence is repeatedly emphasized through the word “witnessing”?
questions.answer: Evidence drawn from direct observation, reflection, and clear signs in creation.

questions.question: What do perfection and comprehensiveness in grandeur point toward?
questions.answer: They point toward a single Lord whose greatness is complete and all-encompassing.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the coming into being of creatures?
questions.answer: They are brought forth in huge numbers, with speed, ease, and excellent workmanship.

questions.question: What do absolute multiplicity and absolute swiftness together point to?
questions.answer: They point to a Creator who can bring many things into existence instantly and powerfully.

questions.question: Why does the connectedness of beings matter in this passage?
questions.answer: Because their shared and intertwined existence suggests one system under one Maker.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by the unity of the sources of order?
questions.answer: The principles directing the universe arise from one command and one Maker.

questions.question: What is the significance of the unity found in the management of the cosmos?
questions.answer: It makes the unity of the Maker evident.

questions.question: How do the widespread elements and species on earth support the same conclusion?
questions.answer: Their spread and dominance across the earth suggest that they are under one ownership and command.

questions.question: What is the basic claim made right after the poetic opening lines in the target passage?
questions.answer: The claim is that Allah alone is the one true deity and that many signs in creation confirm His unity.

questions.question: What is the passage trying to show about the relationship between the universe and belief in one God?
questions.answer: It shows that the structure and activity of the universe support belief in one God.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Divine grandeur and sublimity?
questions.answer: Their vastness, perfection, and all-encompassing character testify to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What three features of creation are brought together when speaking of beings and creatures?
questions.answer: Great number, great speed, and great excellence.
